title: Cash deposits clustered immediately below the currency transaction reporting threshold
definition: Cash deposits that cluster immediately below the currency transaction reporting threshold in force for the monitoring window, across one or more accounts or branches. The indicator describes a measured distribution of amounts; it does not describe intent, and it is not on its own evidence that a reporting requirement was avoided.
evidence_to_cite: each deposit record that forms the cluster, cited by its own source id and pointer
the threshold value in force for the monitoring window, and the date it changed
the subject's declared business profile and stated cash intensity, where one exists
benign_explanations: A cash-intensive legitimate business depositing daily takings that happen to fall below the reporting threshold.
A business splitting deposits across branches for operational reasons such as a branch's daily cash limit or a till shortage.
Seasonal or end-of-week takings that cluster below the threshold by coincidence of trading volume.
A recently formed business whose declared cash intensity is below its actual takings because it has not yet been re-profiled.

sources.citation: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, currency transaction reporting requirements and the aggregation rule, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.

notes: The benign explanations are the most valuable part of this record. An indicator without them is a detector with no false-positive population.
